# domeneshop_domains (Data Source)

List the domains in the account, optionally narrowed by a substring filter.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) Only return domains whose name contains this string.

### Read-Only

- `domains` (Attributes List) The matching domains. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains))

<a id="nestedatt--domains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domains`

Read-Only:

- `dns` (Boolean) Whether Domeneshop hosts the DNS.
- `domain` (String) The domain name.
- `email` (Boolean) Whether the email service is active.
- `expiry_date` (String) Date the registration expires.
- `id` (Number) The domain's numeric id.
- `nameservers` (List of String) The domain's nameservers.
- `registered_date` (String) Date the domain was registered.
- `registrant` (String) The registrant's name.
- `registrar` (Boolean) Whether Domeneshop is the registrar.
- `renew` (Boolean) Whether the domain auto-renews.
- `status` (String) The domain's lifecycle status.
- `webhotel` (String) The web-hosting plan, or `none`.
